messages:
sara (devex): Help needed. New user ran `ri quickstart` and the CLI immediately printed `402 Payment Required` then retried repeatedly for ~4 minutes. They never saw a billing prompt during signup. Should CLI treat 402 as terminal?

kevin (sdk): can you paste the raw CLI log chunk? curious if retries are from our http client or the CLI wrapper.

sara (devex): user pasted:
```
2026-04-02T09:12:01Z ri-cli INFO POST /v1/chat -> 402 Payment Required
2026-04-02T09:12:01Z ri-cli WARN retrying request 1/8 after 1200ms
2026-04-02T09:12:02Z ri-cli INFO POST /v1/chat -> 402 Payment Required
2026-04-02T09:12:04Z ri-cli WARN retrying request 2/8 after 1600ms
... continues until cli exits
```
They said `ri account status` returned no workspace and `billing_state: pending`.

kevin (sdk): aha. Our Go client treats any 4xx as non-network error and a later middleware decided to retry unless explicitly blacklisted. Node and Go clients diverged after last retry refactor. Python is fine (no retries for 401/402).

li (infra): From infra POV, 402 should not be retried. It's not transient. Retrying can cause lots of noise and hides the real problem.

kevin (sdk): plan: patch retry policy to mark 401/402 as terminal across all SDKs and add an option to CLI `--no-retry-on-client-error`. I'll open a single cross-repo issue and link PRs.

sara (devex): UX suggestions: 1) If 402, print clear action: "Billing required: visit console.redwood.ai/settings/billing or run `ri billing add-card`" 2) show org id and a link to create workspace 3) exit non-zero immediately (no retry) 4) small help blurb about free credits vs payment required.

kevin (sdk): opened issue RD-3145 and PR drafts: go-sdk#589, node-sdk#722. Also adding an automatic smoke test which simulates a blocked org and asserts CLI prints helpful message and exits within 2s.

ci-bot: go-sdk#589 passed unit tests; node-sdk#722 awaiting review.

li (infra): I'll add a metric to capture "retries on 4xx" so we can detect regressions and support spikes.

sara (devex): for the support case I replied with troubleshooting steps:
- run `ri account status` and share `org_id` and `billing_state`
- if `billing_state` is `blocked` or `missing_payment_method` follow billing link above
- if signup shows completed but no workspace, escalate to Prod Oncall with org id

kevin (sdk): also adding a small CLI tip: `ri workspace create --quickstart` when account is ready.

ci-bot: Deployed ri-cli v0.10.1-beta to staging with non-retry 401/402 behavior. Run smoke suite: quickstart-blocked-org.json

li (infra): thanks all. marking RD-3145 as DX-onboarding and assigning to sara for KB update.
